subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.description: Grade 8 foundational mathematics covering rational numbers, linear equations, geometry, and algebraic expressions.

chapters.title: Rational Numbers
chapters.description: Properties of rational numbers, closure, commutativity, and number line representation.

concepts.name: Properties of Rational Numbers
concepts.description: Closure, commutativity, and associativity under basic arithmetic operations.
concepts.learning_objective: Understand and apply closure, commutative, and associative properties.

concepts.name: Representation on the Number Line
concepts.description: Locating and spacing positive and negative rational numbers on a continuous line.
concepts.learning_objective: Accurately plot and find intermediate fractions on a coordinate line.

chapters.title: Linear Equations in One Variable
chapters.description: Solving algebraic equations with one variable on one or both sides.

concepts.name: Solving Linear Equations
concepts.description: Transposition and balance methods for solving single-variable linear equations.
concepts.learning_objective: Solve single variable equations with variables on one or both sides.

concepts.name: Word Problems & Real-World Modeling
concepts.description: Translating word problems into mathematical linear equations.
concepts.learning_objective: Formulate and solve equations representing age, geometry, and rate problems.

chapters.title: Understanding Quadrilaterals
chapters.description: Polygons, angle sum property, and classification of quadrilaterals.

concepts.name: Angle Sum Property & Polygons
concepts.description: Interior and exterior angle sum formulas for convex polygons.
concepts.learning_objective: Calculate interior and exterior angle sums for any n-sided polygon.

concepts.name: Special Quadrilaterals & Properties
concepts.description: Properties of parallelograms, rhombuses, rectangles, and squares.
concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish diagonals, angles, and sides of special quadrilaterals.

subjects.name: Science
subjects.description: Grade 8 foundational science covering physics, chemistry, and biology concepts.

chapters.title: Cell — Structure and Functions
chapters.description: Fundamental unit of life, cell organelles, and difference between plant and animal cells.

concepts.name: Cell Structure and Organelles
concepts.description: Nucleus, cytoplasm, cell membrane, mitochondria, and plastids.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify key cell organelles and their metabolic roles.

concepts.name: Plant vs Animal Cells
concepts.description: Cell wall, chloroplasts, large vacuoles, and comparative physiology.
concepts.learning_objective: Compare and contrast structural distinctions between plant and animal cells.

chapters.title: Force and Pressure
chapters.description: Contact and non-contact forces, pressure, and fluid pressure principles.

concepts.name: Types of Forces
concepts.description: Muscular, friction, magnetic, electrostatic, and gravitational forces.
concepts.learning_objective: Differentiate between contact and non-contact forces in nature.

concepts.name: Pressure and Fluid Pressure
concepts.description: Force per unit area, atmospheric pressure, and pressure in liquids.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain the inverse relation of area to pressure and liquid depth variation.

chapters.title: Light and Reflection
chapters.description: Laws of reflection, regular vs diffused reflection, and human eye structure.

concepts.name: Laws of Reflection
concepts.description: Angle of incidence equals angle of reflection; normal, incident, and reflected ray.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply the laws of specular reflection to plane and spherical surfaces.

concepts.name: Human Eye & Vision Care
concepts.description: Cornea, iris, pupil, lens, retina, rods, and cones.
concepts.learning_objective: Describe how the eye focuses images on the retina and vision defects.
